title: Black Off-Shoulder Gown on the Street
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight dark hair and rectangular glasses stands on a city street in front of a red-brick building. She wears a fitted black off-shoulder long-sleeve maxi dress with a structured corset-style waist and a small heart pendant. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, late-afternoon light and parked cars behind her. Palette of black, brick red, and silver. Sleek and dramatic, in the style of an evening street-style photo.
workingNotes:
- The off-shoulder neckline and corset waist are the key shapes.
- Keep the brick building for a strong architectural backdrop.
tryThis: Try this: Keep the brick building as an architectural backdrop.
